purpose: Cross-family Basic Five evaluation with a fully frozen pretrained backbone and one minimal attention-based reader.
design_principle: Preserve the dataset, split, input, epoch count, task head, and metric of BASIC5_FAIR_v1. Add only a one-block attention reader or adapter and make only the optimizer changes required to train it reliably.

global_rules.pretrained_weights: Use the released pretrained checkpoint as-is; no intermediate adaptation or task-specific pretraining.
trainable_scope: the same task head used by BASIC5_FAIR_v1

feature_extraction.layer: Use the same single canonical feature layer as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; default to the final pre-classifier representation.
feature_extraction.spatial_tasks: A method must expose spatial tokens or a spatial feature map. Otherwise report UNSUPPORTED; do not substitute a global feature.
feature_extraction.token_preprocessing: Remove non-spatial special tokens for dense prediction. Preserve patch-grid order. Do not concatenate extra layers unless BASIC5_FAIR_v1 already requires it.
feature_extraction.feature_cache: Allowed only when it is mathematically exact for the frozen backbone and fixed augmentation; otherwise extract online. Apply the same policy to every compared model.

dense_and_detection.topology: C-to-256 projection, one residual self-attention/MLP block on the spatial grid, 256-to-C zero-initialized projection, then the unchanged task head
dense_and_detection.multiscale_rule: Apply the same shared adapter weights independently at each selected feature scale.

reader.parameter_budget_reporting: Report trainable reader parameters, task-head parameters, and their percentage of total model parameters.

global_rules.hyperparameter_policy: One canonical recipe per task, applied unchanged to every backbone. No model-specific learning-rate sweep, query-count change, width change, or layer selection.
global_rules.precision: AMP/bfloat16 permitted; keep numerically sensitive losses and metrics in float32.

input.train: random resized crop to 224, scale [0.08, 1.0], ratio [0.75, 1.3333], random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 256, center crop 224
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

imagenet1k.feature_and_pooling: All final-layer patch tokens attend to 32 learned queries; mean-pool query outputs; do not add CLS/global tokens unless they are the model's only canonical token representation.
imagenet1k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 1000-class classifier
imagenet1k.trainable_scope: attention reader, its projections/norms, and linear classifier only
imagenet1k.augmentation: Identical to the frozen-linear baseline; no Mixup, CutMix, label smoothing, RandAugment, or random erasing.
imagenet1k.minimal_deviation_note: Only the linear readout is preceded by the shared attention reader. AdamW replaces linear-probe SGD because the reader contains attention, normalization, and learned queries.

input.train: random horizontal flip p=0.5; resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization before feature extraction

coco.feature_and_pooling: Preserve spatial/multiscale features. Insert the shared one-block spatial adapter immediately before the unchanged FPN; never globally pool.
coco.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 Faster R-CNN detector, including unchanged FPN, RPN, RoIAlign, box classifier, and box regressor
coco.trainable_scope: spatial attention adapter plus the complete Faster R-CNN/FPN detection head; backbone fully frozen

optimization.schedule: step decay by 0.1 at epochs 8 and 11

coco.augmentation: Identical to the frozen-linear baseline: scale resize and horizontal flip only.
coco.loss: standard Faster R-CNN RPN and RoI classification/regression losses
coco.minimal_deviation_note: The detector, 1x schedule, SGD recipe, batch size, and augmentation are unchanged; only the frozen-backbone feature adapter is added.

input.train: random resize scale [0.5, 2.0], random 224x224 crop, random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: single-scale 224x224 evaluation using the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 resize/crop policy
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

ade20k.feature_and_pooling: Reshape final-layer patch tokens to their 2-D grid, apply the one-block residual spatial adapter, apply the unchanged 1x1 Conv, and bilinearly upsample logits to target size with align_corners=false.
ade20k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 1x1 Conv with 150 outputs
ade20k.trainable_scope: spatial attention adapter and 1x1 Conv only
ade20k.augmentation: Same geometry as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; no photometric policy beyond the baseline.
ade20k.loss: pixel-wise cross entropy with ignore_index=255 and no auxiliary decoder loss
ade20k.minimal_deviation_note: Dataset, 20-epoch schedule, spatial feature layer, 1x1 head, upsampling, and metric remain fixed; one residual spatial attention adapter is inserted before the head.

nyuv2.split: official Eigen-style 795 train / 654 test from labeled.mat and splits.mat

input.train: resize/crop to 224x224, random horizontal flip p=0.5, using the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 geometry
input.evaluation: deterministic 224x224 transform and the same valid-pixel mask as BASIC5_FAIR_v1
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

nyuv2.feature_and_pooling: Reshape final-layer patch tokens to their 2-D grid, apply the one-block residual spatial adapter, apply the unchanged 1x1 depth head, and bilinearly upsample with align_corners=false.
nyuv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 single-channel 1x1 Conv depth head with positive depth parameterization
nyuv2.trainable_scope: spatial attention adapter and 1x1 depth head only
nyuv2.augmentation: Same geometry as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; no Mixup, CutMix, or task-specific pretraining.
nyuv2.loss: the same valid-pixel scale-invariant log-depth loss as BASIC5_FAIR_v1
nyuv2.minimal_deviation_note: The official 795/654 split, depth mask/range, 30 epochs, 1x1 head, loss, and reporting stay fixed; only the residual spatial attention adapter and its optimizer-appropriate weight decay are added.

input.temporal_sampling: one frame uniformly sampled from each of 16 equal temporal segments; random within segment for training, segment center for evaluation
input.train: per-frame random resized crop to 224 with temporally consistent parameters; horizontal flip disabled
input.evaluation: one temporal clip and one spatial center crop at 224
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

ssv2.feature_and_pooling: For image backbones, spatially mean-pool each frame's patch tokens and feed the 16 ordered frame tokens to the 32-query reader. For native video backbones, feed the ordered final-layer spatiotemporal tokens directly. Mean-pool query outputs; do not temporal-mean-pool before attention.
ssv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 174-class classifier
ssv2.trainable_scope: attention reader, its projections/norms, and linear classifier only

optimization.gradient_accumulation: use as needed to reach effective batch size 256

ssv2.augmentation: Same spatial and temporal policy as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; no Mixup, CutMix, RandAugment, random erasing, or horizontal flip.
ssv2.minimal_deviation_note: The 16-frame input, 50 epochs, classifier, and evaluation views remain fixed. Ordered tokens replace pre-classifier temporal mean pooling so the minimal attention reader can measure temporal readout capacity.

reporting.checkpoint_rule: Use the final scheduled epoch for the canonical score. Do not select on the reported validation/test split. A best-validation checkpoint may be reported only as a clearly labeled secondary result when a separate validation split exists.
reporting.seed_aggregation: Report mean and standard deviation over seeds 0, 1, and 2; retain every per-seed result.
required_metadata: effective batch size and realized learning rate
per-seed metrics, mean, and standard deviation
reporting.unsupported_rule: Report UNSUPPORTED with the reason; never replace a task or feature type silently.
reporting.comparability_rule: Only results following this file without model-specific tuning belong in the BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_v1 main table.
reporting.failure_rule: Do not tune a single failing model. Apply a protocol-wide numerical fix to every model, increment the protocol version, and disclose it.

optional_tracks.native_resolution: Allowed only as BASIC5_ATTENTIVE_NATIVE_v1 and must not be mixed into the canonical table.
optional_tracks.coco_2x: 24-epoch COCO results are optional and must be labeled 2x.
optional_tracks.ssv2_native_clip: Native clip length or multi-view testing is optional and must be reported separately.
